claims.text: Named Entity Recognition (NER) in the Biomedical domain involves recognizing entities such as proteins, genes, diseases, treatments, and drugs.
NER systems in the biomedical field extract medical problems, tests, and treatments from clinical documents.
The biomedical domain presents unique challenges for NER compared to general text, including reliance on hand-crafted features and fewer training examples.
Recent advancements in deep learning techniques have improved the performance of NER systems in biomedical contexts.
